note: The hosts the 2026-08-16 pod campaign actually ran, as data. Three RunPod CPU
pods (cpu3c, 2 vCPU, $0.06/hr each; $0.035 for the whole campaign). Endpoints
are ssh_config aliases because RunPod maps sshd to a random external port,
which the harness's bare `ssh <endpoint>` cannot express.
TWO bundles were built, one per OS: probe_build.py ran on tcg4-old (debian-12)
and on tcg4-new (debian-13), and each bundle was run on every host. A single
bundle only ever proves one direction, and the two directions failed for
DIFFERENT reasons -- see the harness README.
Rows 4-7 of the debian-12 bundle vary ONE axis group each on the build pod
itself, so the OS-level axes are held exactly equal and the contingency can
attribute a pass or a failure. Run them in listed order: triton is additive,
python311 is an isolated venv, torch-2.12.1 replaces the system torch.

targets.name: pod-debian12-glibc236
targets.obtain: runpod CPU pod, image python:3.13-slim-bookworm, cpu3c-2-4

targets.name: pod-debian13-glibc241
targets.obtain: runpod CPU pod, image python:3.13-slim-trixie, cpu3c-2-4

targets.name: pod-ubuntu2404-glibc239
targets.axis_intent: glibc-2.39 / GLIBCXX_3.4.33 / g++ 13.3 — one step either side of both build hosts
targets.obtain: runpod CPU pod, image ubuntu:24.04, cpu3c-2-4, torch==2.13.0+cpu in a venv
setup: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3 python3-venv >/dev/null 2>&1

targets.name: pod-debian12-triton-present
targets.axis_intent: triton — absent on the build host, present here; every other axis identical
targets.obtain: the build pod itself, plus `pip install triton`

targets.name: pod-debian12-python311
targets.axis_intent: python_abi cp313 -> cp311 with the OS and the torch build held identical
targets.obtain: the build pod's distro python 3.11 in a venv with the same torch==2.13.0+cpu
setup: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv >/dev/null 2>&1

targets.name: pod-debian12-torch-2.12.1
targets.axis_intent: torch_version/torch_git/torch_config_digest one MINOR below the build host (2.13.0 is the only 2.13 patch published on the cpu index, so a patch step is unobtainable)

targets.name: pod-debian12-torch-2.12.1-no-triton
